name: Xpel Argan Oil Hair Treatment 100ml With Moroccan Argan Oil Extract
description:
Xpel Argan Oil Hair Treatment 100ml – With Moroccan Argan Oil Extract (Made in UK)

Revitalize your hair with Xpel Argan Oil Hair Treatment, enriched with Moroccan Argan Oil and Vitamin E for deep hydration and nourishment.

Key Benefits:

Intensive Hydration: Rejuvenates dry and damaged hair, leaving it soft, smooth, and healthy.

Reduces Frizz & Adds Shine: Concentrated formula protects hair while enhancing natural shine.

Natural Antioxidant: Nourishes and restores hair vitality with the power of argan oil.

Easy to Use: Apply 2–3 drops to towel-dried hair, distribute evenly, leave in, and style as usual.

Perfect For: All hair types looking for hydration, frizz control, and healthy shine.

Volume: 100ml | Origin: UK
